n.story:
Your role is undergoing a radical transformation from a manual transcriber to a data architect and quality assurance specialist. In the past, you spent your days tethered to a keyboard, moving information from paper or PDFs into databases. Now, AI-driven extraction tools handle the bulk of ingestion, instantly converting unstructured documents into clean, structured data. This shift eliminates the drudgery of repetitive typing and allows you to focus on the high-level logic of how data is organized and utilized.

You have evolved into a 'Data Orchestrator.' Instead of entering rows, you are now using natural language to generate complex SQL queries and statistical models that find hidden patterns in the information you manage. Your expertise is no longer in speed of input, but in the accuracy of your oversight—ensuring that the AI adheres to security policies and business logic. You are the human-in-the-loop who validates anomalies that the machine flags, turning raw data into actionable insights for your organization.

Applying advanced statistical analysis to identify business trends
